known_owner_blockers: Production trusted reviewer executors are currently empty, so ATTESTED_ISOLATED review is unavailable until a current-session trusted executor is proven. This blocks only promotion/release operations that explicitly require that tier; it no longer blocks every safe candidate generation.
External media generation is only as executable as the current session's real image/video/audio tools/provider adapters and authorization. Repository declarations do not fabricate provider access.

Current provider quality rankings are intentionally unpopulated until owner benchmark runs bind exact outputs/evidence under compatible rubrics/calibration scopes. Official provider documentation establishes capabilities/limits, not our production quality score.
Learning candidates do not mutate production authority by themselves; durable promotion requires owner maintenance plus tests/replay and verified write evidence.
Live published-episode growth/IP/commercial outcome verification remains open after executable architecture validation.

Programmatic graphics is now executable only for constrained non-character typography/data/quote explainer shots. It is a silent synthetic candidate route, not cinematic AI-video generation, real/product-truth evidence, IPOS identity rendering, final sound or automatic release.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Understand source media, subjects, events, context, facts, evidence and uncertainty
gaps: Deterministic source-byte and quote-grounding checks are registered; no live search, external fact oracle or semantic video/audio/image understanding provider is registered.

source_media_understanding.scope: Interpret complete relevant source media; evidence audit is not semantic perception.

source_audio_transcription.scope: Actual transcription provider or session tool; distinguish transcript from audio quality.

research_and_fact_check.scope: Current original-source research and semantic fact check; local audit verifies supplied bytes/quotes only.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Independent long and short content, argument, story, tone, translation and localization
gaps: EditorialPlan validation is not long-form writing or native-language creative quality.

short_form_copy.selection_notes: Use for standalone short posts and captions. Ground the angle in the actual source; T-002 is optional and applies only when a question or contrast is immediately legible.

long_form_editorial.selection_notes: Build a reader journey around the material and reader job. Select structure from the argument; do not force a universal article template.

narrative_and_script.selection_notes: Use narrative and script techniques only when a narrative/script deliverable is requested; do not inherit video stages for a text-only task.

multilingual_localization.selection_notes: Preserve the underlying content promise while localizing idiom, rhythm and cultural references for each requested language.

news_satire_packaging.selection_notes: Candidate only. Select only when the source is genuinely news/current affairs and the requested treatment is satire; preserve factual and fiction boundaries.

long_form_editorial.scope: Actual authoring and independent editorial judgment; video-plan validator is not article writing.

short_form_copy.scope: Actual concise copy; no video-plan validation.

narrative_and_script.scope: Narrative writing; plan validator applies only to explicitly supplied video EditorialPlan.

multilingual_localization.scope: Native-language adaptation, preserve meaning and platform voice.

news_satire_packaging.scope: Only factual current-affairs satire with source evidence, not generic game footage.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Aesthetics, art direction, composition, typography, image concept, generation, editing and variants
gaps: Local render routes are limited graphics/rendering mechanisms; no registered general image generation, editing or enhancement executor.

visual_concept.scope: Art direction/concept, not actual rendered image; no generation effect.

cover_design.scope: Actual cover composition and typography; prepare-only scope does not authorize rendering.

avatar_design.scope: Temporary avatar design; permanent identity has separate explicit IPOS scope.

image_generation.scope: Current image-generation operation required; registered MP4 renderers are not image generators.

image_editing.scope: Current image-edit operation and source reference required.

image_aspect_adaptation.scope: Per-variant composition; do not substitute unrequested crop.

image_enhancement.scope: Actual enhancement operation and pixel review.

programmatic_motion_graphics.scope: Motion graphic MP4 candidate only, from a declared render spec, required assets and authorized code; not general image generation or final video acceptance. Also supports an explicitly requested analysis report of its own render receipt, not a generic creative analysis.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Original moving-media production, direction, shot design, continuity, assembly and sound design
gaps: Shot routing and validation do not generate a video; generative providers require current-session handshake.

video_concept.scope: Concept only; local graph initialization is optional metadata, not video production.

storyboard_and_direction.scope: Storyboard and direction; supplied shot contracts only.

shot_design.scope: Declared shot design and evidence-bound route support, not generation.

video_generation.scope: Current actual generation operation required; no registered generative video executor.

animation_and_motion.scope: Actual animation; local programmable motion render only with approved spec, code and inputs.

sound_design.scope: Actual sound design; no local audio creation claim.

video_assembly.scope: Assembly only from existing inputs and timeline; does not promise original audio packet identity. Also supports an explicitly requested analysis report of its own assembly or timeline/continuity evidence, not arbitrary research.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Non-destructive media edits, trims, reframe, enhancement, restoration, audio preservation and accessibility
gaps: Original FFmpegAssembler reencodes audio. A separate, narrowly-scoped ffmpeg_video_audio_copy operation proves encoded-audio packet identity for eligible source media, not general audio restoration or arbitrary video editing.
Only video passthrough, geometry crop, and end-trim can prove copied encoded-audio payloads; advanced content restoration, AI enhancement and multitrack transformations remain unavailable.

video_trim.scope: Eligible end-trim only for local packet-copy route; other trims need separate executor.

video_merge.scope: Actual merge; local packet-copy editor does not merge.

video_reframe.scope: Eligible geometry crop only for local packet-copy route; other reframing separate.

video_enhancement.scope: Actual enhancement; packet-copy operation is not AI enhancement.

original_audio_preservation.scope: Eligible passthrough/geometry crop/end-trim with exact encoded audio packet proof; reject unsupported transformations. Supports an explicitly requested analysis report of its own audio-identity receipt from the same edit operation, not unrelated analysis.

audio_enhancement.scope: Actual audio enhancement, not video packet copy.

audio_restoration.scope: Actual audio restoration; scope and audio promise must be compatible.

subtitles.scope: Actual transcript, timing and subtitle rendering/sidecar as requested.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Platform-native titles, descriptions, tags, cover copy, variants and distribution preparation
gaps: Legacy editorial_packaging.py is a narrow case validator, not a registered generic packaging executor. Delivery packaging does not write promotional copy.

platform_title.selection_notes: The title earns entry with a truthful promise or point of tension; it is not a plot summary or a guaranteed CTR device.

platform_description.selection_notes: The description supplies context, voice or meaning that the title does not already perform.

platform_tags.selection_notes: Use relevant discovery context only. No fixed hashtag count unless the owner or current platform specification requires one.

cover_copy.selection_notes: Cover text has its own visual click job. The image concept may be art-directed beyond a literal video frame, but must remain grounded in the content.

platform_native_variant.selection_notes: Adapt the same underlying content promise to the requested platform and locale; do not invent separate channel strategies unless requested.

platform_spec_research.selection_notes: Research current official platform specifications only when they materially affect the requested output.

platform_title.scope: Actual title writing; archive packaging is not writing.

platform_tags.scope: Current relevant tags; no invented trends.

platform_native_variant.scope: Requested locale/platform/shape only; archive packaging is optional support for already produced assets.

platform_spec_research.scope: Current platform rules require primary-source verification.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Nested Social Media Studio original identity/IPOS: temporary avatar, persistent design, approved canon use, continuity and derivatives, with separately custodied permanent canon
gaps: Original durable canon belongs to IPOS; ordinary avatar/temporary character work does not automatically invoke IPOS.
IPOS is an internal product subsystem, but its current Skill/private canonical state is not copied or stored as Video owner data. Only verified approved bundles enter downstream media effects.

temporary_character.scope: Temporary design only; no IPOS bundle, state or canon access.

approved_identity_use.scope: Exact current approved bundle and rights; read-only canon consumption.

identity_continuity.scope: Only current canon-dependent scope; declared metadata does not prove achieved fidelity.

persistent_identity_design.scope: Existing IPOS specialist workflow, separately custodied owner canon; no automatic mutation.

identity_derivative_production.scope: Approved identity derivative only; exact bundle and rights.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Audience research, experiments, commercial fit, rights and measured outcomes
gaps: Outcome measurement is not live audience validation or commercial success.

audience_strategy.scope: Actual audience evidence and strategy; business object validation only.

commercial_design.scope: Commercial fit, truth and authorized constraints; schema validation only.

experiment_design.scope: Hypothesis and experiment design; optional declared episode handoff only.

business_measurement.scope: Actual outcome receipts; derived metrics do not prove causation.

professional_capability_groups.scope: Artifact-specific technical and independent semantic acceptance, safe delivery
gaps: Technical measurement is not aesthetic or editorial acceptance; independent reviewer availability must be verified.

technical_media_qa.scope: Inspect exact media bytes; technical measurements not aesthetic PASS. Supports explicitly requested technical measurement reports on exact media bytes, not general semantic or creative review.

editorial_quality_review.scope: Inspect actual text and independent evidence where required.

visual_quality_review.scope: Inspect actual pixels/full playback as applicable; no self-rating substitutes.

independent_acceptance.scope: Independent reviewer provenance and actual owner result; no self-attestation.

delivery.scope: Return the requested artifact, not a plan; no posting authorization.

current_route_policy: Current route is authoritative only for locating actual registered mechanisms; historical fields never confer execution authority; no automatic task selection.
